Title: Service Public, “Quels sont les numéros en cas d'urgence (Samu, pompiers...) et les numéros d'écoute ?”
Notes: Reachable Service-Public page verified 25 Aug 2026. It lists emergency 15/112 and 114 access modes; it is not a hospital-admission or hospital-charge authority.

Title: Ministry of the Interior, “Information à destination des personnes déplacées d'Ukraine et souhaitant demander une protection temporaire en France”
Notes: Interior Ministry page published 10 Mar 2022. It lists the original Ukraine-related categories and 2022 procedure; the 2026 EU military-obligation condition is absent. Keep for historical/category context, paired with the 2026 EU decision for current conditions.

Title: Légifrance, CESEDA Article R. 581-4
Notes: Légifrance text is in force as at 18 Nov 2026. Article R581-4 states APS validity of six months, automatic renewal during temporary protection (with validity possibly limited to remaining period), and right to work.

Title: Urssaf, *DPAE - Réaliser la déclaration préalable à l’embauche*
Notes: Urssaf DPAE page is officially indexed, updated 17 Apr 2025; it requires declarations for employees in the general social-security system before taking up work, within the eight-day window.

Title: France Travail, “Ai-je droit à l’allocation chômage ?”
Notes: France Travail ARE page is current and lists multiple eligibility requirements, including registration, residence and prior work conditions; it does not establish ADA or OFII responsibilities.

Title: Action Logement, “Garantie Visale”
Notes: Action Logement page lists current Visale eligibility groups and describes the rent-guarantee function; the general eligibility list does not expressly establish APS-BPT eligibility.

Title: Assurance Maladie (ameli.fr), “Vous êtes né à l’étranger et vous demandez votre numéro de sécurité sociale”
Notes: Ameli foreign-born social-security number page describes temporary NIA and definitive NIR allocation and civil-status proof. It is not an APS entitlement or Carte Vitale guide.

Title: France Travail, “Vous êtes déplacés ukrainiens, trouvez des informations ici”
Notes: Current France Travail Ukraine information page remains accessible and describes work-search support, a needs form and service access. Its content does not establish every current registration or unemployment-benefit rule.

Title: Préfecture de la Seine-Maritime, “Je souhaite demander un titre de séjour de droit commun” (Ukraine / protection temporaire)
Notes: Seine-Maritime prefecture page is officially indexed and updated 16 Jan 2026. It gives a department-specific route, listed grounds, filing channels and instruction to renew APS during review.

Title: Assurance Maladie (ameli.fr), “Obtenir une attestation de droits”
Notes: Ameli page explains how to download an attestation of rights. It is current administrative guidance, not a general rule on healthcare eligibility or NIR issuance.

Title: Urssaf, *Montant du Smic*
Notes: Urssaf page is officially indexed, updated 1 Jun 2026; it gives the exact 2026 hourly and monthly gross SMIC rates and age/territory variations.

Title: Ministry of Higher Education, “Venir étudier en France”
Notes: MESR page was published 30 Jun 2026 and gives current student-arrival routes, including DAP and language-test information, with different directions for applicants in France/abroad.

Title: France Travail / Mes aides, “Ateliers-Conseils : Préparer sa candidature”
Notes: France Travail Mes aides page is officially indexed and updated 16 Jun 2026; it describes candidate-preparation workshops. It does not establish France Travail’s legal institutional status.

Title: Ministry of National Education, Circular 2012-141, “Organisation de la scolarité des élèves allophones nouvellement arrivés”
Notes: The 2012 circular remains an official education reference and is still cited by Eduscol’s 2026 EANA resources; it sets the organization/assessment framework for newly arrived allophone pupils.

Title: France Travail, “La Préparation Opérationnelle à l’Emploi individuelle (POEI)”
SuccessorURL: Same official page URL; current page title is POE
Notes: Current France Travail POE page is accessible and describes employer-linked training before recruitment with eligibility and contract conditions. Its current title uses POE; the source record’s POEI wording is stale.

Title: Légifrance, Arrêté du 22 mai 2026 relatif au relèvement du salaire minimum de croissance
Notes: Légifrance order of 22 May 2026 is the official legal instrument for the 1 Jun 2026 SMIC rise. It remains the relevant rate-setting order at the cutoff.

Title: Service-Public, foreign nationals and family benefits
Notes: Service-Public foreign-family-benefits page was verified 16 Oct 2026. It states foreign-national and residence/document conditions for family benefits; it does not by itself establish Ukraine-specific derogations.

Title: Service-Public / DILA, “Aide personnalisée au logement (APL)” (F12006)
Notes: Service-Public APL page verified 1 Jul 2026; it describes general APL conditions, Caf/MSA route and calculation context. It is not a local Ukraine-specific entitlement source.

Title: Légifrance, CESEDA Article L. 412-3
Notes: Légifrance Article L412-3 is in force (checked through 8 Oct 2026); it permits specified student, trainee and mobility cards without the long-stay visa. It is a limited statutory exception list.

Title: Service Public, “Les frais en cas d'hospitalisation et de passage aux urgences ont augmenté le 1er mars”
Notes: Service-Public article describes hospital daily charge and emergency-patient fee changes effective 1 Mar 2026 and exemptions including CSS/AME.

Title: Assurance Maladie (ameli.fr), “La participation forfaitaire de 2 €” and “La franchise médicale”
Notes: Ameli page dated 29 Sep 2026 states the €2 consultation/medical-act participation and daily cap. This is not the hospital daily charge or emergency-patient fee.

Title: Service-Public / DILA, “Faire une demande de logement social (HLM)” (F10007)
Notes: Service-Public HLM page verified 11 Sep 2026; application can be online or paper and wait depends partly on location. It does not concern APL, FSL or Visale.

Title: Service Public, “Qu’est-ce que la protection universelle maladie (Puma) ?”
Notes: Service-Public PUMa page verified 13 May 2026. It describes standard work/residence basis and application route, and flags a future participation contribution awaiting decree.

Title: Council of the European Union, Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/1912, consolidated text with Corrigendum C1
Notes: Official consolidated EUR-Lex decision (including corrigendum) is current. It extends TP to 4 Mar 2028 from 5 Mar 2027; Article 2 adds military-obligation/proof requirements from 5 Aug 2026 and the continuous same-state exception.

Title: Service-Public, “RSA : demandeur de 25 ans et plus”
Notes: Service-Public RSA page verified 1 Apr 2026; it describes RSA conditions and CAF/MSA route. It does not establish ARE, ADA, or complete TP-specific exclusions.

Title: Service-Public, “Prime d’activité : salarié ou fonctionnaire”
Notes: Service-Public Prime d’activité page verified 1 Jun 2026; it describes the worker benefit and CAF/MSA application. It does not establish all claims about RSA, ARE or ADA.

Notes: Service-Public ADA page is accessible and explicitly says it is under revision after 2026 Pact decrees, including a decree of 6 Oct 2026. Title: Assurance Maladie (ameli.fr), “La protection universelle maladie”
Notes: Ameli PUMa page is accessible current guidance; supports standard PUMa principles, but not the separate 2025/Ukraine temporary-protection arrangement.

Notes: Service-Public Entreprendre page concerns liberal professions (including regulated professions within that scope); it does not establish rules for every regulated occupation.

Title: Ministry / Eduscol, “Ressources pour l’accueil et la scolarisation des élèves allophones nouvellement arrivés (EANA)”
Notes: Eduscol resource page dated Feb 2026 supplies current EANA practitioner resources. It is a resource page, not the full legal basis for every placement/hour proposition.

Title: Parcoursup, “Étudiants internationaux” FAQ
Notes: Parcoursup FAQ is current for 2026 applicants and explicitly distinguishes French baccalaureate/first-cycle Parcoursup from DAP for some foreign-diploma cases. It does not establish Ukraine-specific or tuition/CROUS rules.

Title: Préfecture de la Haute-Garonne, “Ukraine : mobilisation des services de l’État dans le département”
Notes: Haute-Garonne prefecture page was updated 9 Sep 2026; it documents local orientation to emergency accommodation then temporary housing. Scope is Haute-Garonne only.

Title: Service-Public / DILA, “Futur locataire d’un logement privé : justificatifs à donner au propriétaire” (F1169)
Notes: Service-Public private-rental documents page is live and current; lists permitted supporting documents including foreign passports. It is not a source for discrimination, rent controls, lease terms or acceptance of APS-BPT as a substitute.

Title: France Travail, foreign-worker registration
Notes: France Travail foreign-worker registration page is current; registration depends on a valid residence document authorizing salaried work, and the general article has age/cohort distinctions. It does not name APS-BPT in the reviewed passage.

Title: Service-Public (DILA), “Carte de résident de longue durée-UE (étranger en France depuis 5 ans)” (F17359)
Notes: Service-Public long-term EU resident page is current and covers qualifying five-year residence, eligible card categories, resources and health cover. It does not establish APS-BPT time-counting.
